text: カンナは　ちえを　めぐらせて　クールに　たたかうが　いがいな　いちめんも　あるらしい？

structure.jp: ちえを　めぐらせて
クールに　たたかうが
いがいな　いちめんも　あるらしい？
structure.en: apparently she also has an unexpected side?

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a verb means 'apparently', going by what people say. いちめんも　あるらしい = 'apparently she has another side too'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. クールに　たたかうが = 'she battles coolly, but'.

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here tells you in what way she battles. ちえを　めぐらせて = 'putting her wits to work'.
